purpose: Pre-change Cloudflare Worker source and non-secret configuration backup. Does not modify running workers.
exclusions: Secret values, TURN credentials and any other write-only Cloudflare secrets
Durable Object / KV / D1 persistent storage contents, which are NOT captured
Account-level zone DNS or API tokens
restoration_notes: GitHub project: use the protected_main_commit to restore the original repository tree/branch state, after checking newer changes.
Cloudflare: source files are stored under each Worker; restore with the original worker name, matching metadata settings and bindings.
Do not blindly redeploy without restoring required secret values, Durable Object bindings/migrations and confirming compatibility.
Cloudflare deployment/version identifiers are documented in each worker metadata.json; version rollback may also be possible in Cloudflare.
